stories.title: Sensex soars nearly 1,000 points on sharp rally in auto and bank stocks
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex climbed 989.94 points to close at 83,021.75, while the Nifty 50 finished at 25,514.30. The gains were driven by auto and bank stocks alongside sustained foreign fund inflows and easing commodity prices. The indices reached their highest levels in nine months.

stories.title: Nifty tops 25,500 for first time since February, Sensex reclaims 83K
stories.summary: Indian markets rose as easing commodity prices and foreign portfolio investment outweighed concerns over the US Federal Reserve. BSE and NSE market capitalization reached a record 512 trillion and 508 trillion respectively on November 12, before settling slightly lower at 511.97 trillion and 506.80 trillion by November 19.

stories.title: Sensex reclaims 83,000 as FII buying tops 1 lakh crore, autos, banks lead rally
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex crossed the 83,000 mark for the first time since geopolitical tensions linked to the Iran conflict unsettled global markets. The rally was supported by sustained foreign institutional investor inflows and strength in banking stocks, reflecting confidence in domestic economic resilience despite lingering uncertainties.

stories.title: Sensex, Nifty surge over 1% as banks, auto stocks drive rally
stories.summary: Indian equity markets rebounded by over 1% on Thursday following three sessions of muted trading. The rally was led by banking and automobile sectors, supported by foreign portfolio investor inflows and lower copper and crude oil prices. The Bank Nifty index reached a fresh all-time high.

stories.title: Sensex surges nearly 1,000 pts, Nifty reclaims 25,500 as auto stocks lead broad-based rally
stories.summary: Benchmark indices recovered from early losses to finish near intraday highs. Strong buying in automobile, consumer durable, and banking stocks helped the Nifty reclaim the 25,500 mark. Information technology stocks remained an exception to the broader rally, which began amid mixed global cues.

stories.title: Dalal Street ends on a high note as Sensex, Nifty rally over 1%
stories.summary: Benchmark indices maintained upward momentum for most of the trading session after recovering from early selling pressure. Heavy buying in heavyweight automobile, banking, and consumer stocks added 4.36 lakh crore to investor wealth. The market gained momentum within the first hour of trading.

stories.title: Sensex jumps nearly 1,000 points, Nifty reclaims 25,500 amid strong FII inflows
stories.summary: Indian stock markets staged a comeback, with the Sensex rising 1.21% to 83,021.75 and the Nifty climbing 1.14% to 25,514.30. The performance was fuelled by foreign fund inflows and a decline in commodity prices. Maruti Suzuki and Axis Bank were among the notable performers.

stories.title: Markets bounce back led by auto, bank stocks
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex jumped 989.94 points to close at 83,021.75, while the Nifty 50 climbed 286.35 points to 25,514.30. The rally was led by auto and bank stocks, including a 7.58% surge in Maruti Suzuki and a 4.38% gain in Axis Bank.

stories.title: Sensex soars 990 pts, Nifty reclaims 25,500 on auto rally
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks recovered as strong buying in automobile and banking stocks helped the Nifty reclaim 25,500. The rally occurred despite US Federal Reserve minutes indicating concerns over persistent inflation. Sustained foreign fund inflows and easing crude oil prices provided the necessary support for the session.

stories.title: Stock market today highlights, November 19
stories.summary: Indian shares bucked a broader Asian selloff, led by auto and financial stocks. The Nifty 50 rose 1.14% to 25,514.30 and the Sensex gained 1.21% to 83,021.75. Fifteen of 16 major sectors advanced, with the auto index climbing 4.4% on the back of strong festival sales.

stories.title: Closing bell: Nifty 50 surges 286 points above 25,500, Sensex jumps 990 points
stories.summary: Benchmark indices erased previous losses as renewed buying in heavyweight automobile, banking, and consumer stocks took hold. The recovery occurred despite uncertainty surrounding the US Federal Reserve interest rate outlook and continued selling pressure in technology stocks. The Nifty 50 ended the day at 25,514.30.

stories.title: Market wrap: Nifty soars 1.14% as auto stocks drive Sensex past 83,000
stories.summary: Markets closed higher with the Nifty rising 1.14% to 25,514.30 and the Sensex adding nearly 1,000 points to hit 83,021.75. The automobile sector rallied over 3.5%, while realty and consumer durables lagged, shedding roughly 2% and 1.7% respectively amid sector-specific selling.

stories.title: Wall Street ends sharply lower as Anthropic's debut fails to revive AI fervor - Reuters
Wall Street tumbles to its longest losing streak since 2024 as the Dow drops 1,100 points - AP News
Anthropic's blockbuster debut tests Wall Street's faith in AI boom - Reuters
Anthropic shares jump 17% after record Wall Street listing
stories.summary: The AI group led by Dario Amodei raised $81 billion in an upsized public offering. The company's shares rose 17% following the debut on Wall Street.

stories.title: Wall Street tumbles to its longest losing streak since 2024
stories.summary: The S&P 500 dropped 2% for a sixth straight loss, marking its longest streak in two and a half years. The index is now down 8.2% from its all-time high. While Anthropic saw a strong debut, broader AI-linked stocks continued to fall.

stories.title: US stocks fall as Anthropic debut fails to lift market
stories.summary: US stocks dropped more than 2 percent on Thursday, marking the longest losing streak since 2024. Despite Anthropic raising $81.3 billion in its initial public offering, the AI giant's market debut failed to reverse broader declines across the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow Jones indices.

stories.title: Indian lender Yes Bank's AT-1 bond investors urge RBI to focus on investor protection - Reuters
RBI deputy governor links mis-selling to sales targets
stories.summary: RBI Deputy Governor S C Murmu stated that financial mis-selling originates from sales targets and variable pay structures rather than branch-level actions. He urged banks to review incentive models to prioritize customer outcomes over volume, noting that outsourcing activities does not absolve banks of their ultimate responsibility.

stories.title: SEBI and PFRDA call for deeper capital markets
stories.summary: SEBI member K.V.R. Murty stated that India requires deeper capital markets and increased domestic savings to fund its Viksit Bharat 2047 ambition. He argued that traditional bank lending and government expenditure are insufficient to sustain an 8 percent GDP growth trajectory without transparent, mobilized securities markets.

stories.title: Yes Bank bondholders seek explanation for RBI review
stories.summary: The Yes Bank AT-1 Bondholders Association has requested that the RBI explain the public interest behind its decision to seek a Supreme Court review of a judgment that restored written-off bonds. The group is also seeking confirmation of supervisory steps to protect individual bondholders during the process.

stories.title: RBI urges bank boards to focus on technology risks
stories.summary: RBI Deputy Governor S C Murmu has directed bank boards to increase oversight of strategy and technology risks. He emphasized the need for preparation regarding the transition to expected credit loss provisioning, which becomes mandatory in April 2027. The central bank expects boards to lead on these transitions.

stories.title: Banks must focus on building strategy and overcoming technology risks, says RBI Deputy Governor - News On AIR
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank has asked banks to focus on building strategy and overcoming risks, especially technology risks. Speaking at an event organised by Excellence Enablers in Mumbai this morning, RBI Deputy Governor S C Murmu said banks need to invest in technology as well as people to ensure there is

stories.summary: Yes Bank AT-1 bondholders have urged the RBI to oversee implementation of the Supreme Court ruling restoring their investments, as the bank and central bank seek a review. stories.title: Sebi approves ICICI Securities PMS business transfer
stories.summary: Market regulator Sebi has approved the transfer of the portfolio management services business from ICICI Securities to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company. The acquisition will be executed as a slump sale on a going-concern basis, following an intimation received by the company on November 19, 2026.

stories.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard report data breach
stories.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard have confirmed that customer data, including email addresses, was exposed during cyberattacks on third-party vendors. The companies acknowledged the incidents following the unauthorized access to vendor systems.

stories.title: Fintech Devengo raises €5 million for expansion
stories.summary: Spanish fintech Devengo has secured €5 million in debt and equity financing to expand its instant account-to-account payment services. The round included participation from Mutua Madrileña, Banco Sabadell, and Bankinter. The company provides infrastructure for automated transfers between accounts and businesses.

stories.title: Payhawk reaches $2 billion valuation in Series C
stories.summary: Fintech company Payhawk has raised $280 million in a Series C funding round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The investment brings the company's valuation to $2 billion and total capital raised to over $515 million. Payhawk currently operates in 33 countries.

stories.title: Government confirms UPI will remain free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry has clarified that UPI payments will remain free for consumers and person-to-person transactions. Any future Merchant Discount Rate charges would apply only to a limited set of merchant transactions above a specific threshold. The government described the move as an effort to ensure long-term sustainability.

stories.title: Tiger Global-backed fintech unicorn Razorpay is reportedly preparing to publicly file documents for its initial public o
Paytm shares fall 8.5% as UPI merchant fee rollout faces delay
stories.summary: Paytm shares fell 8.51 percent and MobiKwik declined 8.06 percent following reports that the government may defer proposed UPI merchant charges until after the 2027 Assembly elections. The delayed rollout postpones potential revenue for payment companies. Uncertainty remains a reliable feature of the sector.

stories.title: Paytm and MobiKwik shares drop on UPI fee uncertainty
stories.summary: Shares of Indian digital payments companies declined as the proposed rollout of UPI merchant transaction fees faced further uncertainty. Paytm fell 6.3 percent, Pine Labs dropped 3.7 percent, and MobiKwik declined 7.3 percent. No revised implementation date has been announced for the fees.

stories.title: PM Modi hails 10 years of UPI, says digital payments revolution a source of pride for every Indian - DD News
UPI marks a decade of real-time payments
stories.summary: Launched in 2016 by the National Payments Corporation of India, the Unified Payments Interface has grown into the world’s largest real-time payments platform. It now powers nearly half of global instant payment transactions and serves as the primary infrastructure for India's digital economy.

stories.title: Qatar Post launches UPI-linked remittance service
stories.summary: Qatar Post has introduced a digital remittance service allowing users to send money directly to UPI-enabled bank accounts in India. Developed with India Post and NPCI International Payments Limited, the service aims to strengthen financial connectivity between the two nations through existing postal networks.

stories.title: NPCI considers flat ₹5 fee for B2B UPI transactions
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India is considering a flat ₹5 fee for merchant-to-merchant UPI payments under a revised merchant discount rate framework. The proposal aims to replace percentage-based charges for B2B transactions. The implementation date for the new fee remains undecided.

stories.title: NPCI mulls flat ₹5 fee for B2B UPI transactions
stories.summary: The NPCI is reportedly considering a flat ₹5 fee for business-to-business UPI transactions to replace percentage-based merchant discount rates. The proposal would cover payments between distributors, retailers, and platforms. The fee has not yet been finalized.

stories.title: A beginner guide to mutual fund analysis
stories.summary: Financial experts suggest that investors looking beyond recent returns and popularity should examine a fund's consistency, downside risk, and expense ratio. Beginners are encouraged to align fund selection with their specific investment goals and time horizons before committing capital.

stories.title: Pensioners seek minimum monthly payout of ₹45,000
stories.summary: The Bharat Pensioners Samaj has proposed raising the minimum government pension to ₹45,000 and increasing the family pension rate to 50 percent. The 7th Pay Commission previously rejected similar demands, citing the impact of successive pay revisions. The 8th Pay Commission is currently reviewing the proposal.

stories.title: EPFO approves investments in alternative funds
stories.summary: The EPFO has received in-principle approval to invest up to 3 percent of its fresh inflows into Alternative Investment Funds. The move aims to diversify the retirement fund's portfolio beyond bonds and ETFs while maintaining existing investment limits and government oversight.

stories.title: EPFO introduces systematic withdrawal plan for retirees
stories.summary: The EPFO has approved a voluntary systematic withdrawal plan allowing retiring members to receive their provident fund savings in periodic instalments. The remaining balance will continue to earn interest. The facility aims to provide a regular income stream for retirees.

stories.title: EPFO faces ₹1.1 lakh crore liability for higher pensions
stories.summary: The EPFO estimates that granting higher pensions to 4.45 lakh applicants could result in a liability of approximately ₹1.1 lakh crore. The potential cost follows a Supreme Court ruling allowing certain subscribers to opt for pension contributions based on higher wages.

stories.title: Gram Panchayats depend on Centre, states for 90% of funds, own revenue just 10%: RBI - Moneycontrol.com
Fixed deposits remain a low-risk option for seniors
stories.summary: Fixed deposits offer senior citizens interest rates 25 to 75 basis points higher than standard rates. While these instruments provide lower returns compared to market-linked investments, they are frequently cited for their safety and lack of required portfolio maintenance.

stories.title: EPFO eases withdrawal and settlement rules
stories.summary: The EPFO has reduced the unemployment waiting period for final settlement to two months and lowered the minimum balance requirement to 10 percent. Additionally, the organisation approved a systematic withdrawal plan to allow retirees to access their savings in instalments.

stories.title: EPFO approves systematic withdrawal plan for retirees
stories.summary: The EPFO has approved a systematic withdrawal plan, allowing retiring subscribers to receive their provident fund savings in periodic instalments rather than a lump sum. The unwithdrawn balance will continue to earn interest at the applicable EPF rate.

stories.title: Car loan down payment: Is it smart to pay 20% upfront or keep the money invested? What should be your ideal strategy? |
stories.summary: Buying a new car generally involves several crucial steps and decisions. Among the most important is deciding how much you should pay as a down payment and how much you should borrow. Now, it is a given that paying 20% upfront can go a long way in reducing the loan

stories.title: Fixed deposit rates reach 8.25 percent in November
stories.summary: Fixed deposit investors can earn up to 8.25 percent interest this month, according to data from Paisabazaar.com. Small finance banks currently lead the market, while private and public lenders offer varying returns. Highest rates remain tied to specific deposit tenures, as is the custom.

stories.title: Tribunal allows capital gains relief despite missed filing deadline
stories.summary: The Jaipur Bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled that tax authorities cannot deny Section 54 capital gains exemptions solely because a taxpayer missed the original filing deadline. The decision requires that taxpayers still meet all substantive conditions for the relief. Deadlines are now apparently optional.
